title: Antigravity Gemini 4 Neon High for AI Game Dev
author: ronR_55
selftext:
Hi everyone. I just wanted to share my thoughts with you about using gemini 4 models for ai game development: 

I started developing my mobile game back in August using Claude (mainly Opus and Fable), and the workflow has been solid so far, usually running Fable 5.2 as the orchestrator and QA helper, with Opus 5.5 subagents doing the coding.

Last week I came across the new Gemini 4 models and all the perks that come with a Pro/Ultra account. I have to say, having Gemini actually "listen" to audio and "watch" videos (claude only checks screenshots and cant listen to sound) has been a huge help for generating animations and vfx, cutscenes and so on. With all its built in capabilities and tools, it feels like the ideal ai setup for game dev.

Neon on high also did a great job reviewing Opus's code and caught quite a few issues. I still have my Claude subscription, but I'm definitely planning to lean more and more into Gemini 4 Neon moving forward. What's your experience with the new Gemini 4 models?
